description: You woke at the edge of rice paddies gone feral, the bunds broken and the ditches full of carp. Wild rice heads in the shallows; lotus stands in the still corners. Water is everywhere and the ground drinks it slowly.
hazard: Summer floods. The paddies remember being a river, and the river remembers the paddies.
name: Paddy Margin
tagline: Feral paddies, carp in the ditches, water everywhere

description: You woke inside a bamboo brake — green poles in every direction, leaf litter deep as a mattress, shoots pushing up through yesterday's footprints. The light comes down in green shafts. Everything here is either food or a spear.
hazard: Dead culms fall silently and land like spears. Don't camp under the old poles in wind.
name: Bamboo Hollow
tagline: A sea of green poles, shoots at your feet

description: You woke in a hutong alley — grey-brick courtyard houses with their gates hanging open, a stone well in every second courtyard, persimmon trees splitting the paving. The tinned food went fast. What the cooks left behind grows on.
hazard: Collapsed courtyard walls and rotten roofing. The wells are fouled — boil everything.
name: Old Hutong
tagline: Grey-brick alleys, courtyard wells, tinned ghosts
